scope: Bounded triage of 22 power_pin_not_driven findings, one ACDRV pin_to_pin conflict and one low-or-float H/L pin_not_driven finding from the isolated native typed ERC. All 24 native findings remain unsuppressed. Exact reported pins are representatives of their connected nets, not an exhaustive consumer list.
method: Join each reported native ERC reference/pin to the current H2 physical contact materialization and native net ledger, then inspect the bounded local source path. Paths shown are observed connectivity, not a full rail-state graph. No production changes, PWR_FLAG additions, exclusions or ERC suppressions.
limits: No new proven missing-driver defect was found among these 22 reports; that is not proof that every rail works.
Converter start-up, switched paths, external-source presence, diode voltage drops and bootstrap behavior remain conditional obligations.
The native ERC errors are not cleared by this triage. A typed source-path or configuration-specific rule is required before accepting an exception.
The separate ACDRV output conflict has a manufacturer-supported VBUS-only configuration explanation below, but remains visible in native ERC and is not globally waived.

The H/L input finding has a manufacturer-supported low-or-floating topology explanation, not a missing pull-up prescription. Shared-module leakage/DC domains, RXD-before-PD sleep/fault sequencing and one-hot control remain unverified by this triage.

input_findings.reason: SA818S H/L pin7 must be pulled low or left floating, never driven high. The actual net has exactly U39.7 and U51.7 receiver inputs plus SN74LVC1G07 U47.4 open-drain Y; there is no external pull-up or push-pull high driver. Generic native input-not-driven ERC does not establish the intended low-or-floating state. This explanation neither changes the input/open-collector types nor suppresses the error, adds a pull-up or qualifies the complete interface.
remaining_obligations: Verify H/L input and inter-module leakage, the released state with either module powered or unpowered, driver sink limits and all signal voltage domains; the module datasheet does not fully characterize DC VIH/VIL/VOH/VOL or internal input circuitry.
Verify RXD is low before PD becomes low for each module during normal sleep, deselection and fault shutdown. An RXD pull-down cannot override an actively high UART transmitter.
Verify one-hot PD/PTT behavior, U47 supply/input/default states and the intended H/L power selection in every transition; this three-endpoint net observation does not prove those states.

evidence.section: Rev1.8 section 9, page10, H/L pin7 low-or-floating control and RXD pin16 low-before-sleep requirement; shared SA818S-U/V interface.
DCK Pin Functions and function table: A pin2, open-drain noninverting Y pin4; no push-pull high drive.

evidence.selector: Complete LESHY2-RF-R2 VOICE_HL_OPEN_DRAIN endpoint set: voice.HL=U39.7; voice_v.HL=U51.7; voice_hl_driver.Y=U47.4; no extra contact or pull-up.

conflicts.reason: BQ25798 VBUS-only mode explicitly ties unused ACDRV1/2 to GND and VAC1/VAC2 to VBUS. Those exact nets are present here; the generic output-output ERC types do not express this configuration. This explanation does not suppress the native conflict or accept the whole electrical gate.
remaining_obligations: Preserve the VBUS-only topology; adding input-mux FETs or moving VAC/ACDRV nets invalidates this explanation.
Implement an exact configuration-scoped check before accepting an ERC exception; never globally suppress output-output conflicts.
